title: Source for a preceding input position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t,p,j$ be natural numbers. The source is bit $j$ of the block for input position $p-1$ at time $t$ if $p\ne0$; otherwise it is the constant false bit.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape alphabet
